description: Fetch MLB data from the official MLB Stats API — player stats, standings, schedules, and teams.

endDate.description: End date for schedule range (e.g. '2024-04-07'). Used for mode=getSchedule.
endDate.title: End Date (YYYY-MM-DD)

maxItems.description: Maximum number of records to return (1–500).
maxItems.title: Max Items

mode.description: What data to fetch from the MLB Stats API.
enumTitles: Get Player Stats — season batting or pitching statistics
Get Standings — team standings by division
Get Schedule — game schedule and results for a date range
Get Teams — list all MLB teams
mode.title: Mode

startDate.description: Start date for schedule range (e.g. '2024-04-01'). Used for mode=getSchedule.
startDate.title: Start Date (YYYY-MM-DD)

statGroup.description: Type of player stats to retrieve (for mode=getPlayerStats).
statGroup.title: Stat Group

teamId.description: Filter by MLB team ID (e.g. 147 = Yankees, 111 = Red Sox). Optional — leave blank for all teams.
teamId.title: Team ID

title: MLB Baseball Stats Scraper Input
